biology.gas-exchange-humans-explain-mult.a: large surface area; thin walls (one cell thick)/short diffusion distance; good blood supply; moist
biology.gas-exchange-humans-explain-mult.b: nicotine/CO raise heart rate/blood pressure and damage artery lining; fatty deposits build up in coronary arteries narrowing them; less blood/oxygen to heart muscle, clots; CO reduces oxygen carried

biology.gas-exchange-humans-ext.0012.all: many alveoli give large surface area; walls one cell thick and capillary walls thin so short diffusion distance; dense capillary network and constant blood flow plus ventilation maintain steep concentration gradients; moist lining for gases to dissolve; O2 diffuses into blood, CO2 out

biology.gas-exchange-humans-mcq-rev.0001.all: Held open by rings of cartilage and carries air to the bronchi

biology.gas-exchange-humans-prac-method..all: sit at rest and count breaths per minute (repeat, mean); exercise e.g. step-ups for set time (1,2,3,4,5 min) at same intensity; immediately count breaths for one minute; rest until back to resting rate between; repeat and calculate means

biology.gas-exchange-humans-prac-plan.00.all: C: vary exercise duration (0-5 min); O: same person/similar age and fitness; R: repeat three times, mean; M1: count breaths for 1 minute with stopwatch; M2: immediately after exercise; S: same type/intensity of exercise, rest to baseline between tests

biology.gas-exchange-humans-prac-reliab..a: identify anomalies; calculate mean; results more reliable
biology.gas-exchange-humans-prac-reliab..b: volume/concentration of limewater - use same volume measured with measuring cylinder; or breathing rate/depth - breathe at same rate

biology.gas-exchange-humans-prac-risk.00.a: over-exertion/fainting or tripping - students with health conditions (asthma) don't take part/stop if dizzy; clear space
biology.gas-exchange-humans-prac-risk.00.b: count for a full minute (not 15 s x4) / repeat count / use a stopwatch / have partner count

biology.gas-exchange-humans-prac-step.00.all: so starting rate is the same for each test; otherwise raised breathing from previous exercise would affect result making it invalid

biology.gas-exchange-humans-prac-vars.00.b: time taken for limewater to turn cloudy
biology.gas-exchange-humans-prac-vars.00.c: volume of limewater; concentration of limewater; size of tubes; rate/depth of breathing

biology.gas-exchange-plants-data-graph.0.a: net uptake increases with light intensity, negative at 0, becomes positive (compensation point ~10-15), then levels off at high intensity; quote data
biology.gas-exchange-plants-data-graph.0.b: no light so no photosynthesis; plant still respires; CO2 released so net uptake negative

biology.gas-exchange-plants-data-pct.000.b: no photosynthesis in dark; respiration continues releasing CO2

biology.gas-exchange-plants-data-plot.00.a: axes (x light), scale incl negative y, points, smooth curve
biology.gas-exchange-plants-data-plot.00.b: increases from -8 to 21; crosses zero just above 10; levels off at 21 from 50

biology.gas-exchange-plants-explain.0007.all: control; shows that colour change is caused by the leaf (not light/heat/the air) so result valid

biology.gas-exchange-plants-explain-mult.a: spongy mesophyll cells (cell surfaces lining air spaces)
biology.gas-exchange-plants-explain-mult.b: light increases in morning so photosynthesis rate increases; rate of photosynthesis exceeds respiration; CO2 used faster than released, glasshouse enclosed

biology.gas-exchange-plants-mcq.0001.all: when the rates of photosynthesis and respiration are equal

biology.gas-exchange-plants-mcq-rev.0002.all: Taken in by a leaf in bright light because it is used in photosynthesis

biology.gas-exchange-plants-prac-method..all: use leaves of same species/size; coat upper surface of one, lower of another (and uncoated/both coated controls); record initial mass on balance; hang in same conditions; weigh daily for several days; calculate % mass loss; most loss = surface with more stomata uncoated

biology.gas-exchange-plants-prac-plan.00.all: C: vary light intensity by lamp distance (e.g. 5 distances); O: same species/size leaves; R: repeat 3 times; M: colour of hydrogencarbonate indicator after set time vs colour standards; S: same volume indicator, same temperature (heat filter), same time; sealed tubes, control tube without leaf

biology.gas-exchange-plants-prac-reliab..a: identify anomalies, calculate mean, leaves vary
biology.gas-exchange-plants-prac-reliab..b: uncoated leaf (and/or leaf coated on both surfaces) to compare - shows water loss with no stomata blocked / that loss is through stomata

biology.gas-exchange-plants-prac-risk.00.a: hot lamp - don't touch / let cool; or electrical with water - keep water away
biology.gas-exchange-plants-prac-risk.00.b: compare with colour chart/standards or use a colorimeter

biology.gas-exchange-plants-prac-step.00.all: prevents gas exchange with surrounding air; so any change in CO2 (indicator colour) is due only to the leaf

biology.gas-exchange-plants-prac-vars.00.a: which surface is coated (upper or lower)
biology.gas-exchange-plants-prac-vars.00.b: mass of leaf / mass lost (water lost)
biology.gas-exchange-plants-prac-vars.00.c: same species/size of leaf; temperature; humidity; light; air movement

biology.gas-exchange-humans-prac-risk.00.note: (b) generic MS wording, but digital timer fits and rider accepts sensible methods.

biology.gas-exchange-plants-data-graph.0.note: Graph not visible; MS readings consistent with axis labels.

biology.gas-exchange-plants-data-read.00.note: Graph not visible; MS readings consistent with axis labels.

biology.gas-exchange-plants-prac-risk.00.note: (b) generic MS wording; 'sensor' (colorimeter) and the 'any sensible method' rider cover colour standards.
